description: Email verification API for AI agents: send up to 20 email addresses and get a verdict for each as JSON: status, score, whether the domain exists and has a mail server, disposable, role-based and free-provider flags, catch-all detection and a typo suggestion. Catch-all and strict servers are reported as risky or unknown, never as valid. Pay per address in stablecoins; addresses that got no verdict are refunded. Not offered on Solana: pay on Base or Polygon.

emails.description: email addresses to check, 1 to 20 (duplicates are checked once); the call is priced per address

name: email-verify
title: Verify email addresses
